Requirements: any tool that reads `AGENTS.md` gives you generic adaptation (charter + scripts). F"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"ull adaptation (skills auto-loading) requires DSH; other platforms can adapt from `.dsh/skills/`. Sc"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"ripts need Python 3.10+.
2. Place the repository anywhere (referred to as `{AOS_ROOT}`). No hardcode"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"d paths.

5. Create your first project: follow the two-file pattern (AG"},{"id":"p23s8","text":"ENTS.md + README.md) in `01_PROJECTS/_example_cli_tool/`, or copy any `_example_*` directory. Exampl"},{"id":"p23s9","text":"es include runnable test commands.
6.
